_source: ExPASy PeptideCutter rules (simplified); Lys-C cleaves K-P (PeptideCutter)

values.name: Trypsin
values.desc: Cuts at carboxyl side of lysine and arginine residues, except when followed by proline.

values.name: Chymotrypsin
values.desc: Cuts at carboxyl side of tyrosine, tryptophan, and phenylalanine.

values.name: LysC
values.desc: Cuts at carboxyl side of lysine.

values.name: AspN
values.desc: Cuts at amino side of aspartic acid.

values.name: GluC
values.desc: Cuts at carboxyl side of glutamic acid.

values.name: ArgC
values.desc: Cuts at carboxyl side of arginine.
